svg.aria-label: AswinHari2000 — Flutter Developer | Building Beautiful, Responsive & High-Performance Cross-Platform Mobile Applications with Dart. The camera descends onto a reef grown from the last 52 weeks of contributions; fish named after featured repositories swim past, plankton gathers into the name, and a depth gauge reads 82 metres, the sunlit zone.
